headline: Build Turin's next AI agent startup by turning your GitHub-fueled momentum into a real agentic product that investors and developers are already hunting for.

build.title: AgentForge: A Multi-Agent Startup Research Assistant
build.description: An open-source agentic workflow that autonomously researches startup ideas, validates market demand, and generates pitch decks by orchestrating web-scraping, API calls, and LLM reasoning agents. It impresses because it solves a real founder pain point while showcasing planning, tool use, and collaboration between agents.
deliverables: GitHub repo with modular agent code and docs
Live demo where users input an idea and get a research report
Medium article explaining the architecture and lessons learned

publish: Launch the repo on GitHub with clear README, examples, and a 'contributing' section to drive early stars and forks.
Post a demo video and thread on X/Twitter tagging agentic AI influencers and Turin tech accounts.
Submit to Hugging Face Spaces and write a detailed post on the Hugging Face blog to tap into their community.
Present at the next Turin AI or startup meetup to connect with local founders and potential early users.
skills: LLM orchestration with LangGraph and OpenAI SDK
risks: Agentic systems can be unpredictable and hard to debug, leading to unreliable outputs that hurt user trust.
Rapidly evolving tooling means today's stack may be outdated in months, requiring constant learning and adaptation.
Building in public with a startup focus may attract copycats or distract from deep technical progress.
confidence: This is a high-confidence recommendation: the signals are strong, the stack is mature, and the local-global opportunity in Turin is well-aligned with your founder profile.
